breakpoints.description: Geometric altitude, Z, breakpoint set in meters

functions.description: Table lookup for ambient temperature; returns ambient temperature in degrees C (in variable t_amb_C) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in T_dgC_table.
functions.name: T_dgC_function

functions.description: Table lookup for pressure ratio; returns ambient pressure normalized with SL pressure (in variable p_p0) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in P_P0_table.
functions.name: P_P0_function

functions.description: Table lookup for density ratio; returns density normalized with SL density (in variable sigma) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in sigma_table.
functions.name: sigma_function
